title: Model Adapter Config v0.1
description: Provider/model identity for a single benchmark arm, injected as configuration -- never hardcoded inside Agent or model-adapter code (see domain/agent-comparison/model-adapter.mjs). One ModelConfig maps to exactly one model_config_id used across all telemetry for a run.

model_config_id.description: Stable identifier for this exact provider+model+parameter combination, used to join telemetry back to a configuration without re-deriving it from free text.

kind.description: Which generic adapter implementation to construct. FAKE_DETERMINISTIC never makes a network call. HTTP_CHAT_COMPLETIONS is a single generic OpenAI-Chat-Completions-shaped HTTP client reused across providers that speak that exact envelope. HCX_CHAT_COMPLETIONS (Turn P11-A) is HyperCLOVA X's own distinct request/response envelope (messages/topP/topK/maxTokens fields, a status+result response shape) -- see hcx-model-adapter.mjs; it is never routed through the generic HTTP_CHAT_COMPLETIONS branch. HCX_NATIVE_V3_FUNCTION_CALLING (Turn P11-E) is HCX-005's Native v3 Function Calling protocol -- a forced single submit_grounded_answer tool call, promoted from P11-D's bounded real-API comparison winner -- see hcx-native-function-calling-adapter.mjs; its endpoint hostname is fixed to clovastudio.stream.ntruss.com with no loopback-mock exception. In every case the provider/model/endpoint are fully config-driven, not branched on by name in code.

provider.description: Free-text provider label for telemetry/reporting only (e.g. "anthropic", "openai", "hcx"). Never used to select code paths.

model.description: Free-text model name for telemetry/reporting only (e.g. "claude-sonnet-5"). Never hardcoded inside Agent flow code.

endpoint_url.description: Required when kind=HTTP_CHAT_COMPLETIONS or kind=HCX_CHAT_COMPLETIONS; the full chat-completions-shaped endpoint URL. For HCX_CHAT_COMPLETIONS, must be https:// unless the hostname is an explicitly loopback-authorized mock target (see hcx-model-adapter.mjs).

api_key_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. The key value itself is never part of this config or of any telemetry/log output.

top_p.description: Nucleus-sampling parameter. Required when kind=HCX_CHAT_COMPLETIONS; unused (and optional) for other kinds.

seed_supported.description: Whether this provider/model combination accepts a deterministic sampling seed at all. Required when kind=HCX_CHAT_COMPLETIONS -- a Owner-set false means the adapter never sends a seed field, even if a caller's request supplies one.

input_cost_per_1k_tokens.description: Used only to derive telemetry.estimated_cost; absence means estimated_cost is always 0.

request_schema_version.description: Required when kind=HCX_CHAT_COMPLETIONS. Names the exact HCX request envelope shape this ModelConfig was authored against (see hcx-model-adapter.mjs's SUPPORTED_HCX_REQUEST_SCHEMA_VERSIONS). An unrecognized value fails closed at construction (MODEL_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE) rather than guessing a request shape.

response_schema_version.description: Required when kind=HCX_CHAT_COMPLETIONS. Names the exact HCX response envelope shape this ModelConfig expects to parse (see hcx-model-adapter.mjs's SUPPORTED_HCX_RESPONSE_SCHEMA_VERSIONS). An unrecognized value fails closed at construction (MODEL_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE).

actual_external_call_authorized.description: Required when kind=HCX_CHAT_COMPLETIONS. Owner-controlled authorization to perform a REAL network call against a non-loopback HCX endpoint. false (the only value this Turn ever sets) means the adapter refuses to call a non-loopback endpoint at all -- see hcx-model-adapter.mjs. A loopback (127.0.0.1/localhost/::1) mock endpoint may still be exercised in a test even when this is false, but ONLY via an explicit test-only constructor option, never by this config field alone; every such mock call is still honestly recorded with actual_external_call_authorized=false and actual_external_generation_call_performed=false.

endpoint_url.description: Must be https://clovastudio.stream.ntruss.com/v3/chat-completions/{model} with {model} exactly equal to this config's own `model` field -- both checked at adapter construction time (hcx-native-function-calling-adapter.mjs's assertEndpointAndAuthorization), zero fetch calls if either check fails.

actual_external_call_authorized.description: Must be true for the adapter to construct at all -- there is no loopback-mock exception for this kind (unlike HCX_CHAT_COMPLETIONS's allowLoopbackMockCalls option); tests inject fetchImpl against the real hostname instead.
